sim:2:Deploy a malicious ERC777 token whose tokensReceived hook calls back into the bridge's unlock function.
sim:3:Relay (MockMultisig) delivers a verified unlock message to the router.

sim:6:Re‑entered unlock passes the totalLocked >= amount check (totalLocked still 100) and decrements totalLocked again, resulting in totalLocked[BTK] == -100.
